policies.betterAuth: Better Auth core and every selected official plugin move as one stable-compatible version line with generated schema comparison and reviewed SQL migrations.
policies.databaseBaseline: Every copied Starter project provisions new empty Development and Production PostgreSQL databases from the final selected-pack SQL baseline. Existing data, backfills, dual writes, and compatibility shims are out of scope.
policies.ownedAdapters: StyleKit is the pinned classified design-source library, PowerAI is the pinned page/content donor, Open SaaS and SaaSBoard are pinned product-shell donors, LastSaaS is the completeness checklist, and MapCN is a capability donor. Accepted output is licensed, tested, versioned, Starter-owned, and Cloudflare-native without donor runtime dependencies.
policies.references: Open Design and RunCopilot inform design research or extraction only. Donor Wasp, Prisma, Go, MongoDB, Next.js, Supabase, mock data, and hosted APIs never become generated runtime dependencies by default.
